summary: Fix NPE vulnerabilities, remove dead code, and implement proper logging.
rationale: Addresses Sonar issues S2259 by replacing nullable .orElse(null) with .orElseThrow() or adding explicit null checks. Resolves S125 by removing commented code block in repository. Resolves S106 by replacing System.out.println with SLF4J logging in CourseServicesImpl.

policy_compliance.evidence: Logic for finding entities now throws exceptions instead of returning null/failing later; existing integration tests should verify this behavior.
Logs only contain generic flow info and non-sensitive IDs.
Changes are strictly within the Service and Repository layers.
Replaced silent null failures with explicit IllegalArgumentExceptions.
